title: USB / USB001 / USB002
story: Fred's never-ending album: tracks get added whenever they're ready. It started with Lights Out in January 2022 and grew as a playlist through 2022–2024 (first vinyl, USB001, in 2024). USB002 was ten songs in ten weeks with ten last-minute shows in ten cities from October 2025, with the artwork for each single shot at the shows; the full album and USB002 vinyl followed on 12 December 2025 and USB002 REMIXES on 6 March 2026. Spotify dates every track 2022, so the dates here come from press.
source: Press, see research/usb-release-dates.md
